actions.name: Dimensions
actions.caption: Dimensions
actions.tooltip: View or edit dimensions, such as area, project, or department, that you can assign to sales and purchase documents to distribute costs and analyze transaction history.

actions.name: Line Narration
actions.caption: Line Narration
actions.tooltip: Select this option to enter narration for a particular line.

actions.name: Voucher Narration
actions.caption: Voucher Narration
actions.tooltip: Select this option to enter narration for the voucher.

actions.name: Card
actions.caption: Card
actions.tooltip: View or change detailed information about the record on the document or journal line.

actions.name: Ledger E&ntries
actions.caption: Ledger E&ntries
actions.tooltip: View the history of transactions that have been posted for the selected record.

actions.name: Approvals
actions.caption: Approvals
actions.tooltip: View a list of the records that are waiting to be approved. For example, you can see who requested the record to be approved, when it was sent, and when it is due to be approved.

actions.name: Renumber Document Numbers
actions.caption: Renumber Document Numbers
actions.tooltip: Resort the numbers in the Document No. column to avoid posting errors because the document numbers are not in sequence. Entry applications and line groupings are preserved.

actions.name: Insert Conv. LCY Rndg. Lines
actions.caption: Insert Conv. LCY Rndg. Lines
actions.tooltip: Insert a rounding correction line in the journal. This rounding correction line will balance in LCY when amounts in the foreign currency also balance. You can then post the journal.

actions.name: GetStandardJournals
actions.caption: &Get Standard Journals
actions.tooltip: Select a standard Bank Receipt Voucher to be inserted.

actions.name: SaveAsStandardJournal
actions.caption: &Save as Standard Journal
actions.tooltip: Define the journal lines that you want to use later as a standard journal before you post the journal.

actions.name: Test Report
actions.caption: Test Report
actions.tooltip: View a test report so that you can find and correct any errors before you perform the actual posting of the journal or document.

actions.name: Post
actions.caption: P&ost
actions.tooltip: Finalize the document or journal by posting the amounts and quantities to the related accounts in your company books.

actions.name: Preview
actions.caption: Preview Posting
actions.tooltip: Review the different types of entries that will be created when you post the document or journal.

actions.name: PostAndPrint
actions.caption: Post and &Print
actions.tooltip: Finalize and prepare to print the document or journal. The values and quantities are posted to the related accounts. A report request window where you can specify what to include on the print-out.

actions.name: Remove From Job Queue
actions.caption: Remove From Job Queue
actions.tooltip: Remove the scheduled processing of this record from the job queue.

actions.name: IncomingDocCard
actions.caption: View Incoming Document
actions.tooltip: View any incoming document records and file attachments that exist for the entry or document.

actions.name: SelectIncomingDoc
actions.caption: Select Incoming Document
actions.tooltip: Select an incoming document record and file attachment that you want to link to the entry or document.

actions.name: IncomingDocAttachFile
actions.caption: Create Incoming Document from File
actions.tooltip: Create an incoming document record by selecting a file to attach, and then link the incoming document record to the entry or document.

actions.name: RemoveIncomingDoc
actions.caption: Remove Incoming Document
actions.tooltip: Remove any incoming document records and file attachments.

actions.name: ImportBankStatement
actions.caption: Import Bank Statement
actions.tooltip: Import electronic bank statements from your bank to populate with data about actual bank transactions.

actions.name: ShowStatementLineDetails
actions.caption: Bank Statement Details
actions.tooltip: View the content of the imported bank statement file, such as account number, posting date, and amounts.

properties.RunPageLink: "Data Exch. No." = field("Data Exch. Entry No."), "Line No." = field("Data Exch. Line No.")

actions.name: Reconcile
actions.caption: Reconcile
actions.tooltip: View the balances on bank accounts that are marked for reconciliation, usually liquid accounts.

actions.name: Apply Entries
actions.caption: Apply Entries
actions.tooltip: Apply the payment amount on a journal line to a sales or purchase document that was already posted for a customer or vendor. This updates the amount on the posted document, and the document can either be partially paid, or closed as paid or refunded.

actions.name: Match
actions.caption: Apply Automatically
actions.tooltip: Apply payments to their related open entries based on data matches between bank transaction text and entry information.

actions.name: AddMappingRule
actions.caption: Map Text to Account
actions.tooltip: Associate text on payments with debit, credit, and balancing accounts, so payments are posted to the accounts when you post payments. The payments are not applied to invoices or credit memos, and are suited for recurring cash receipts or expenses.

actions.name: SendApprovalRequestJournalBatch
actions.caption: Journal Batch
actions.tooltip: Send all journal lines for approval, also those that you may not see because of filters.

actions.name: SendApprovalRequestJournalLine
actions.caption: Selected Journal Lines
actions.tooltip: Send selected journal lines for approval.

actions.name: CancelApprovalRequestJournalBatch
actions.caption: Journal Batch
actions.tooltip: Cancel sending all journal lines for approval, also those that you may not see because of filters.

actions.name: CancelApprovalRequestJournalLine
actions.caption: Selected Journal Lines
actions.tooltip: Cancel sending selected journal lines for approval.

actions.name: Approve
actions.caption: Approve
actions.tooltip: Approve the requested changes.

actions.name: Reject
actions.caption: Reject
actions.tooltip: Reject the approval request.

actions.name: Delegate
actions.caption: Delegate
actions.tooltip: Delegate the approval to a substitute approver.

actions.name: Comments
actions.caption: Comments
actions.tooltip: View or add comments for the record.

actions.name: G/L Accounts Opening balance
actions.caption: G/L Accounts Opening balance
actions.tooltip: Creates Bank Receipt Voucher line per G/L account to enable manual entry of G/L account open balances during the setup of a new company

actions.name: Customers Opening balance
actions.caption: Customers Opening balance
actions.tooltip: Creates Bank Receipt Voucher line per Customer to enable manual entry of Customer open balances during the setup of a new company

actions.name: Vendors Opening balance
actions.caption: Vendors Opening balance
actions.tooltip: Creates a Bank Receipt Voucher line for each vendor. This lets you manually enter open balances for vendors when you set up a new company.

actions.name: EditInExcel
actions.caption: Edit in Excel
actions.tooltip: Send the data in the journal to an Excel file for analysis or editing.

actions.name: PreviousDocNumberTrx
actions.caption: Previous Doc No.
actions.tooltip: Navigate to previous document number for current batch.

actions.name: NextDocNumberTrx
actions.caption: Next Doc No.
actions.tooltip: Navigate to next document number for current batch.

actions.name: ClassicView
actions.caption: Show More Columns
actions.tooltip: View all available fields. Fields not frequently used are currently hidden.

actions.name: SimpleView
actions.caption: Show Fewer Columns
actions.tooltip: Hide fields that are not frequently used.

actions.name: New Doc No.
actions.caption: New Document Number
actions.tooltip: Creates a new document number.

controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the VAT business posting group that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the VAT product posting group that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bill-to/Pay-to No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the bill-to customer or pay-to vendor that the entry is linked to.

controls.name: Ship-to/Order Address Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the address code of the ship-to customer or order-from vendor that the entry is linked to.

controls.name: Payment Terms Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code that represents the payments terms that apply to the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Applied Automatically

controls.name: Applies-to Doc. No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the posted document that this document or journal line will be applied to when you post, for example to register payment.

controls.name: Applies-to ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the ID of entries that will be applied to when you choose the Apply Entries action.

controls.name: On Hold
controls.tooltip: Specifies if the journal line has been invoiced, and you execute the payment suggestions batch job, or you create a finance charge memo or reminder.

controls.name: Bank Payment Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code for the payment type to be used for the entry on the payment journal line.

controls.name: Reason Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the reason code that has been entered on the journal lines.

controls.name: Correction
controls.tooltip: Specifies the entry as a corrective entry. You can use the field if you need to post a corrective entry to an account.

controls.name: Comment
controls.tooltip: Specifies a comment about the activity on the journal line. Note that the comment is not carried forward to posted entries.

controls.name: Direct Debit Mandate ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the identification of the direct-debit mandate that is being used on the journal lines to process a direct debit collection.

controls.name: Shortcut Dimension 1 Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.

controls.name: Shortcut Dimension 2 Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 2, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.

actions.tooltip: View a list of the records that are waiting to be approved. For example, you can see who requested the record to be approved, when it was sent, and when it is due to be approved.

actions.name: Renumber Document Numbers

actions.tooltip: Insert a rounding correction line in the journal. This rounding correction line will balance in LCY when amounts in the foreign currency also balance. You can then post the journal.

actions.tooltip: Select a standard general journal to be inserted.

actions.name: SaveAsStandardJournal

actions.tooltip: Define the journal lines that you want to use later as a standard journal before you post the journal.

actions.name: Test Report
actions.caption: Test Report
actions.tooltip: View a test report so that you can find and correct any errors before you perform the actual posting of the journal or document.

actions.name: Post

actions.name: Preview

actions.name: PostAndPrint

actions.name: Apply Entries
actions.caption: Apply Entries
actions.tooltip: Apply the payment amount on a journal line to a sales or purchase document that was already posted for a customer or vendor. This updates the amount on the posted document, and the document can either be partially paid, or closed as paid or refunded.

actions.name: Match
actions.caption: Apply Automatically
actions.tooltip: Apply payments to their related open entries based on data matches between bank transaction text and entry information.

actions.name: AddMappingRule
actions.caption: Map Text to Account
actions.tooltip: Associate text on payments with debit, credit, and balancing accounts, so payments are posted to the accounts when you post payments. The payments are not applied to invoices or credit memos, and are suited for recurring cash receipts or expenses.
